periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the cranium.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical axis is approximately 1.8 times the width of the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, smooth U-shaped curvature along the posterior edge of the dark transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, comprising approximately 35% of the visible torso length between the neck and the hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex semicircular curvature with a slight flattening at the superior-most apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible chromatostatic variation in the posterior pelvic region fur, exhibiting a yellowish-brown tint compared to the bright white dorsal fur.
